correctness.rationale: The free-algebra calculation is correct over an arbitrary field. For w in the subalgebra generated by the frozen variables, D_w replaces one occurrence of x_i by w and strictly lowers the x_i-count, so it is locally nilpotent. Abelianization sends D_w to the coefficient-wise image of w times partial_{x_i}; hence the kernel on these elementary LNDs is exactly the commutator ideal of the frozen free algebra. The degree-d kernel dimension is (n-1)^d minus the degree-d commutative monomial count, giving the stated Hilbert series. For n>=3, D(x_1)=[x_2,x_3], D(x_j)=0 is an explicit nonzero invisible LND. Combined with the rank-two zero-detection result of Baltazar--Lopes--Morales and the trivial rank-one case, this proves the stated sharp threshold over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field. No boundary-case defect was found.

originality.rationale: The recent Baltazar--Lopes--Morales preprint treats the rank-two free algebra and analyzes abelianization there; older Crode--Shestakov and Drensky--Makar-Limanov results concern rank-two triangulability and kernels, while the Drensky--Yu rank-three survey concerns automorphisms and coordinates. Targeted searches for the higher-rank abelianization threshold, the prototype coefficient [x_2,x_3], and the exact elementary-fiber/Hilbert-series statement did not locate a prior covering theorem. The mechanism is elementary and the novelty claim is therefore narrow: the pass is for the explicit sharp threshold and fiber description as a new synthesis, not for triangular LNDs or commutator ideals themselves.

scientific_value.rationale: Although technically elementary, the result gives a sharp structural boundary for a property highlighted by the newest rank-two work: abelianization detects zero LNDs in rank two but already has an exponentially large invisible elementary-LND kernel from rank three onward. The affine-fiber description and graded dimension formula quantify the failure rather than merely exhibiting one example, making the statement a useful diagnostic for attempts to transfer rank-two LND phenomena to higher free rank.
